note: Best-effort tests mirror the MAIN secvitals catalog (config/catalog.yaml): real-world-style payloads fired SINGLE-ENDED at PUBLIC origins (tmNIDS/testmynids.org, EICAR, Google Safe Browsing test pages, category hosts). They are realistic and independent — they run on a customer-adjacent network and use the same signatures a real attacker would trip — but the result is a HEURISTIC local read (allowed/blocked/error): the customer's IDS/IPS MAY OR MAY NOT register an event, and there is no far-end proof that it did. This catalog is DISPLAY-ONLY for the POC's --manifest, so the ground-truth and best-effort tiers can be shown side by side; the dual-ended run does not fire these (they have no reflector far-end). In the product this tier is run by the existing secvitals console.
